item.title: Netoge no Sekai de Deatta Kyonyuu Kanojo to Off Pako!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Momoiro Pocket
  • 発売日: 2022-12-23
  • スコア: 6.01/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ネトゲの世界で出会った巨乳彼女とおふぱこ！
  • 英語名: Netoge no Sekai de Deatta Kyonyuu Kanojo to Off Pako!

あらすじ

The protagonist is immersed in the largest MMORPG in Japan called “A Kuu”. Not going to school, he spends his days only doing quests. Then one day, suddenly he wondered. There are a lot of female avatars in the game, but how many of them are actually women?

item.title: Bukkake Onmyouji Emaki ~H na Oharai Itashimasu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Momoiro Pocket
  • 発売日: 2021-08-27
  • スコア: 5.7299999999999995/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ぶっかけ陰陽師絵巻 ～Hなお祓いいたします～
  • 英語名: Bukkake Onmyouji Emaki H na Oharai Itashimasu

あらすじ

A story in a world where Yokai coexist.

In Hinomoto, a country that had chosen to coexist with Yokai, many incidents occur because of evil Yokai, but the existence of “Onmyoji” was the way to solve these problems.

However, a new “Curse” has been spreading…

Many Onmyoji have gathered to exorcise the “Curse” except the protagonist “Zen Kamono”, due to being a member of a fallen onmyoji family.

item.title: Ore wa Hime Bushou o Haramasetai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Momoiro Pocket
  • 発売日: 2020-06-26
  • スコア: 5.779999999999999/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: オレは姫武将を孕ませたい！
  • 英語名: Ore wa Hime Bushou o Haramasetai!

あらすじ

Keitaro Sudo has traveled back in time to the Sengoku period, and a beautiful girl who calls herself Nobunaga Oda appears before him!?

Keitaro decides to live in the Sengoku period surrounded by warlord princesses… and while being seduced by them, he has to decide who he will serve.

Getting tossed about in a world of war and turmoil all while aiming for heaven with a warlord princess!

item.title: Custom Cute ~Ore to Kanojo no Ikusei Battle!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Momoiro Pocket
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 5.2700000000000005/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カスタムcute ～俺と彼女の育成バトル！～
  • 英語名: Custom Cute Ore to Kanojo no Ikusei Battle!

别名

  • カスタムキョ~ト ～俺と彼女の育成バトル！～

あらすじ

This is the first game by Momoiro Pocket. Takuma leads a lonely school life and craves to fall in love. There are a few girls who provide him with moral support, but they’re all not his type. Desperate to break free from the monotonous days, he decided to change them to his ideal. However, he will have to overcome their own ideals first!
